title: Canonical admission dry-side conductivity floor repair
problem: The production-shaped builder uses K_FLOOR=1e-10 both in the K error metric and when storing log(K). For represented very-dry O05 states this can replace authoritative conductivities near 1e-22 cm/day by an artificial 1e-10 lookup value.

authority.dry_relevance_rule: raw C=1e-13 bounds adaptive support; outside the table use authoritative analytical fallback
authority.conductivity_semantics: No physical K truncation is admitted inside the represented domain.
